network_status.network: Eventi meteorologici estremi in Calabria - novembre 2011
network_status.summary_it: La fonte tecnica ARPACAL identifica il collasso ferroviario sul Cancello, affluente dell'Amato, e ne descrive lo scalzamento, ma pubblica dati pluviometrici e non un livello o una portata evento-specifici alla sezione del ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The ARPACAL technical source identifies the railway collapse on the Cancello, a tributary of the Amato, and describes scour, but publishes rainfall data rather than an event-specific stage or discharge at the bridge section.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
